status: FROZEN on 10 November 2026, before the formal runs; unchanged afterwards

trust_fusion.equation: T = alpha*S_ID + beta*S_B + gamma*S_C; T = 0 when S_ID = 0

behaviour.equations: A = max(0, (L - mu_L) / (sigma_L + epsilon)), sigma_L = sample SD; S_B = 100*exp(-lambda*A)

thresholds.mapping: T < tau_Q: QUARANTINE; tau_Q <= T < tau_R: RESTRICT; T >= tau_R: FULL_ACCESS

confirmation.rule: a state-change request is sent only after N consecutive windows propose the same state; de-escalation by score is denied (RESTORE is an explicit operator action)

missing_evidence: no proposal; current permissions kept (never treated as healthy)

recovery_rule.name: POST_RESTORE_ONE_WINDOW_V1
recovery_rule.rule: after a verified operator RESTORE the device's first score-ready AE window is recorded and held (no request, confirmation run reset); identity and context-only decisions are not suppressed

liveness_rule: RESTRICT recommendation when silent longer than 3 x AE window + 10 s with complete observer coverage, after a delivery in the current policy generation; intervals explained by a verified client reconnection and observer outages never count; no trust score; always operator review
automatic_enforcement: device02 only, for autoencoder-caused RESTRICT/QUARANTINE; every other cause and device goes to operator review
models: see models_by_device.csv (model, calibration mu_L and sample sigma_L per device) and frozen_model_files_sha256.csv
